main_text.p: aliqua necessitate & vtilitate facta. Magi, opera sua faciunt, vel per caussas naturales, vel ope Dæmonū, vtuntur multis præstigiis, mendaciis, ludificationibus hominū, figuris, characteribus, verbis vel nihil, vel absurda significantibus, aliisq; super stitiosis ceremoniis: miscentq; sacra profanis: nāq; nonnulla verba sacra, quæ vsurpant, adiunctis supstitionibus fœdant & contaminant. Docent enim ea dici debere sub certo quōda costellatiōnū situ, certo loco & tempore, toties signo crucis facto, tot cādelis accensis, adhibitis, vel filis, aut velis, aut chartis, quas vel pueri vel virgines tantū tetigerint: adhibent etiā quædam, quæ nihil prorsus ad effectum producendum pertinent, sed ridiculam habent vanitatem, dicunt enim oportere tali hora & toties, & tali aqua lauare saciem, radere capillos: hac, vel illa veste indui. Sed quod impietatis plenissimum est, sanguinem ex humano corpore mittunt, eoque libamina quædam confecrant, nomina quorundam dæmonū vsurpant, quibusdam animalibus familiariter vtuntur, & cum eis colloquuntur, Dæmonibus sacrificant, no-men

page.notes: Page is a single running column; a marginal word "men" at lower right is the line-end fragment, transcribed as the continuation. Some words in italic and a short Latin phrase ("tali aqua lauare saciem") are uncertain at the bracketed sign; "lauare saciem" reads as "lauare faciem" with a ligature sign [?]. Running head read as ANGELOGRAPHIÆ.
